intro x
let S := LieSubalgebra.engel K x
have hS : LieSubalgebra K L S := by apply LieSubalgebra.mk
have hS_fg : FiniteDimensional K ↥S := by apply Module.Finite.submodule_fg
let ad_x := LieAlgebra.ad K L x
let ad_S := LieAlgebra.ad K (↥S) x
have h_ad_comp_incl : ad_x ∘ₗ (LieSubalgebra.incl K S) = (LieSubalgebra.incl K S) ∘ₗ ad_S :=
  by apply LieSubalgebra.ad_comp_incl_eq
have h_ad_S_nilpotent : LieRing.IsNilpotent (↥S) :=
  by apply LieSubalgebra.isNilpotent_of_engel
let charpoly := LinearMap.charpoly ad_x
let natTrailingDegree := charpoly.natTrailingDegree
have h_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank :
  Module.finrank K ↥S = (LinearMap.charpoly ad_x).natTrailingDegree :=
  by {
    have h_ad_S_nilpotent' : LieRing.IsNilpotent (↥S) := h_ad_S_nilpotent
    let Φ := LinearMap.traceForm K L
    have hΦ_nondeg : Φ.Nondegenerate := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.nondegenerate_traceForm
    have hΦ_inv : LinearMap.BilinForm.lieInvariant L Φ := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.traceForm_lieInvariant
    have hΦ_refl : Φ.IsRefl := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.traceForm_isRefl
    have hΦ_restrict_nondeg : Φ.restrict (↥S) Nondegenerate :=
      by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_nondegenerate
    have hΦ_restrict_inv : LinearMap.BilinForm.lieInvariant (↥S) (Φ.restrict (↥S)) :=
      by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_lieInvariant
    have hΦ_restrict_refl : (Φ.restrict (↥S)).IsRefl := by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.restrict_isRefl
    have hΦ_restrict_atomistic : LinearMap.BilinForm.atomistic (↥S) (Φ.restrict (↥S)) :=
      by apply LinearMap.BilinForm.atomistic_restrict
    let traceForm_S := Φ.restrict (↥S)
    have h_traceForm_S_nondegenerate := hΦ_restrict_nondeg
    have h_traceForm_S_inv := hΦ_restrict_inv
    have h_traceForm_S_refl := hΦ_restrict_refl
    have h_traceForm_S_atomistic := hΦ_restrict_atomistic
    let traceForm_S_charpoly := LinearMap.charpoly (ad_S)
    let traceForm_S_natTrailingDegree := traceForm_S_charpoly.natTrailingDegree
    have h_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank :
      Module.finrank K ↥S = traceForm_S_charpoly.natTrailingDegree :=
      by {
        have h_ad_S_nilpotent'' : LieRing.IsNilpotent (↥S) := h_ad_S_nilpotent
        have h_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank :=
          by apply LieModule.traceForm_eq_sum_finrank_nsmul_mul
        exact h_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank
      }
    have h_charpoly_deg_eq_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg :=
      by {
        have h_ad_S_nilpotent''' : LieRing.IsNilpotent (↥S) := h_ad_S_nilpotent
        have h_charpoly_deg_eq_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg :=
          by apply LinearMap.charpoly_ad_eq_traceForm_charpoly
        exact h_charpoly_deg_eq_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg
      }
    have h_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank :=
      by {
        exact h_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank.trans h_charpoly_deg_eq_traceForm_S_charpoly_deg
      }
    exact h_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank
  }
exact h_charpoly_deg_eq_finrank
